cohort: The study participants were 200 pregnant women, 100 of whom experienced acute cerebrovascular events associated with preeclampsia, and 100 who had preeclampsia without stroke.
finding: Advanced maternal age (>35 years), obesity, maternal family history of stroke, and a history of stillbirth were identified as key predictors of stroke in pregnant women with preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean sections were more frequent in pregnant women with preeclampsia who experienced stroke.
